evt-001.name: Canary Islands Jazz Nights
evt-001.description: A night of jazz under the stars at the iconic Auditorio.

evt-002.name: Romería of San Roque
evt-002.description: Traditional pilgrimage festival with ox carts, traditional costumes and local products.

evt-003.name: Antiques and Crafts Market
evt-003.description: Vintage items and handmade crafts next to the seafront square.

evt-004.name: Costa de Tenerife Trail Run
evt-004.description: Coastal trail race with 10K and 21K distances.

evt-005.name: Fiestas del Cristo
evt-005.description: Street festivities, live music and traditional processions.

evt-006.name: Children's Day at Loro Parque
evt-006.description: Special activities and animal shows for children.

evt-007.name: Sunset Concert Series
evt-007.description: Live acoustic sessions as the sun sets over the Atlantic.
evt-007.venue: Playa de las Américas seafront promenade

evt-008.name: Garachico Crafts Market
evt-008.description: Local artisans sell ceramics, textiles and preserves.

evt-009.name: Festivities in Honour of the Virgin of Candelaria
evt-009.description: The island's great religious festival, with processions and fireworks.

evt-010.name: Tenerife Open Surf Championship
evt-010.description: Local and international surfers compete on the south coast.

evt-011.name: Cultural White Night
evt-011.description: Museums, galleries and historic buildings stay open late with free admission.

evt-012.name: Chamber Music Series
evt-012.description: Classical chamber ensembles perform in the concert hall.

evt-013.name: Autumn Children's Fair
evt-013.description: Games, workshops and puppet shows for the whole family.

evt-014.name: Autumn Special Edition of the Market
evt-014.description: Expanded stalls with seasonal produce and local food.

evt-015.name: Fiestas del Valle
evt-015.description: Three days of concerts, food and fireworks in the historic centre.

evt-016.name: Tenerife Half Marathon
evt-016.description: Coastal half marathon finishing on the seafront promenade.

evt-017.name: International Film Week
evt-017.description: A week of independent and international film screenings.

evt-018.name: University Choir Winter Concert
evt-018.description: The University of La Laguna choir performs seasonal choral works.

evt-019.name: Reggaeton Beach Festival Tenerife
evt-019.description: Tenerife premiere of Europe's biggest urban beach festival, with live reggaeton by the sea.

evt-020.name: Tenerife Cook Music Fest
evt-020.description: Three themed nights (urban, Latin and tropical) with international artists such as Don Omar, Chayanne and Lola Índigo, in its 5th anniversary.
evt-020.venue: Santa Cruz de Tenerife port esplanade

evt-021.name: Fiesta del Charco
evt-021.description: A festival of National Tourist Interest reviving traditional mullet fishing by stunning the coastal pool, preceded by the Bajada de la Rama and a large romería.

evt-022.name: WOMAD Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
evt-022.description: International festival of world music, arts and dance, with free open-air concerts by the port.

evt-023.name: Canary Islands International Music Festival
evt-023.description: The festival's 42nd edition, with major orchestras and international soloists performing at the Auditorio over several weeks.

evt-024.name: Santa Cruz de Tenerife Carnival
evt-024.description: The Carnival's most intense days, themed 'Latin Rhythms', with the Coso Apoteosis on Carnival Tuesday filling the streets with music and colour.

evt-025.name: Holy Week in La Laguna
evt-025.description: Traditional processions through the historic centre, regarded as among the finest in the Canary Islands.

evt-026.name: Santa Cruz de Tenerife Book Fair
evt-026.description: Five days of literary activity with more than twenty-five bookseller and publisher stands in the middle of the park.

evt-027.name: MUECA Festival
evt-027.description: International Street Arts Festival: theatre, dance, circus and music taking over the historic centre's squares and streets for four days.

evt-028.name: Corpus Christi Festivities — Carpet Day
evt-028.description: Thousands of people visit La Orotava to see the flower and volcanic-sand carpets covering the historic centre's streets.

evt-029.name: Regional Romería of San Benito Abad
evt-029.description: Regional pilgrimage with decorated carts and folk groups from all over the island, preceded by the blessing of San Benito's bread.

evt-030.name: Pinolere Fair
evt-030.description: Nearly two hundred craftspeople gather on the slope of the La Orotava valley; this edition revolves around wood.

evt-031.name: Starmus VIII — In Search of the Truth
evt-031.description: Nobel laureates, astronauts and international artists such as Brian May and Andrea Bocelli gather around science, music and the future of the planet.

evt-032.name: Santa Cruz de Tenerife International Half Marathon
evt-032.description: 12th edition of the race, with 8 and 21 kilometre distances along the capital's waterfront.
evt-032.venue: Start and finish in the city centre

evt-033.name: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria Carnival
evt-033.description: One of the Canary Islands' most emblematic festivals: the Grand Drag Queen Gala, the election of the Queen and huge parades.

evt-034.name: Festival of Our Lady of the Pine
evt-034.description: A great romería-offering for the patron saint of the Diocese of the Canary Islands, with carts from every municipality on the island and traditional costumes.
evt-034.venue: Basilica of Our Lady of the Pine

evt-035.name: Canarias Jazz & More International Festival
evt-035.description: Concerts by world-class jazz, soul and funk artists outdoors by Las Canteras beach.

evt-036.name: Festivities of Our Lady of Los Dolores
evt-036.description: Patron saint of Lanzarote: a pilgrimage of walkers in traditional dress and an island crafts fair.
evt-036.venue: Hermitage of Los Dolores, Mancha Blanca

evt-037.name: Club La Santa Ironman Lanzarote
evt-037.description: One of the world's toughest and most legendary triathlons: 3.8 km swim, 180 km bike and a full marathon run.

evt-038.name: Teguise Sunday Market
evt-038.description: The Canary Islands' most important popular market, with traditional crafts, volcanic products and live folklore.

evt-039.name: Fuerteventura International Kite Festival
evt-039.description: Hundreds of giant and acrobatic kites fill the sky above the dunes in an internationally renowned visual spectacle.
evt-039.venue: Playa del Burro, Corralejo Dunes Natural Park

evt-040.name: Romería of the Virgin of La Peña
evt-040.description: Night pilgrimage through Fuerteventura's ravines to the island's patron saint.
evt-040.venue: Sanctuary of Our Lady of La Peña, Vega de Río Palmas

evt-041.name: Transvulcania Ultramarathon
evt-041.description: The great 73 km ultra trail running along the volcanic ridge and the Roque de los Muchachos down to the sea.
evt-041.venue: Route of the Volcanoes, La Palma

evt-042.name: Hiking and Mountain Festival
evt-042.description: Guided routes through laurel forests, night-time stargazing and environmental talks.
evt-042.venue: Plaza de España and island trails
